name: design-studio
description: Describe an app screen and get three or four distinct HTML and Tailwind directions side by side, each checked by a critic agent against concrete anti-AI-look rules. Pick one, refine it with comments, and export HTML, PNG or a React component.
author: dawneflanagan
highlights: Three or four structurally different screen directions per prompt, shown side by side in sandboxed previews
A critic agent checks every draft against concrete rules (type scale, one accent, 4/8px grid, real content, WCAG AA contrast) and fixes it before you see it as reviewed
One editable design system per project (colours, fonts, radii, spacing, type scale) that every variant follows
Refine a chosen screen with plain-language comments; each refinement is a new round you can compare
Export as HTML, a PNG screenshot rendered locally, or a React + Tailwind (shadcn/ui) component
useCases: When you need a first screen for a new feature and do not know where to start visually, describe it and compare three directions the design-studio-designer agent drew
When a screen you built looks generated, ask for the same screen here and let the design-studio-critic agent apply the anti-ai-look-design rules to it
When you have picked a direction, leave a comment like 'make the table the hero' and get refined takes on that one screen
When the screen is right, ask the design-studio-exporter agent for a React + Tailwind component and copy it into your project
configuration: Needs Google Chrome or Chromium on this computer for screenshots and PNG export; previews in the page work without it
Everything stays on this computer: projects live in the app's data folder, and previews and renders load no web fonts, images or scripts
